package: Neo Child Clinic Desktop UI/UX design package
policy: One fresh AI session per batch. A screen's variants stay in the same batch and every image counts toward the limit.

screens.name: Sign in
screens.summary: Sign-in base is clean and complete, but the 1920 wide variant is broken: the form is clipped at 1366px, the panel stops at 768px high and most of the canvas is blank.

issues.observation: Wide capture is severely clipped: heading, supporting copy, fields and button are cut off at 1366px, the dark panel ends at 768px height, and the lower and right areas of the 1920x1080 canvas are empty.

screens.name: Restoring session
screens.summary: Session-restore screen is complete and legible, with clear progress, step states and balanced centring.

screens.name: Session expired
screens.summary: Session-expired dialog is complete and readable; background dimming, fields and both actions fit cleanly.

screens.name: Access denied
screens.summary: Access-denied state is complete and consistent, with clear guidance, visible actions and no broken data.

screens.name: Sign out with pending writes
screens.summary: Pending-writes sign-out dialog fits cleanly; grouped changes, conflict warning and all three actions are legible.

screens.name: Global search
screens.summary: Search overlay is complete and legible; only the wrapped footer key hint is a minor cosmetic flaw.

issues.observation: Footer hint "Up/Down to move - Enter to open" wraps "open" onto a second line, so the left hint is two lines while the right note remains one.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.summary: Base and dark dashboards look polished, but the wide variant loses the right column, fourth KPI, actions and status pills, leaving most of the canvas empty.

issues.observation: Wide dashboard is confined to the top-left area: today's collections KPI, Needs attention and Due today cards, header actions and row status badges are missing, with large empty areas right and below.
Today's clinic header says "6 of 18 visits shown" but only five visit rows are visible and there is no scroll affordance.
Patient avatar initials are very low contrast against the teal circles in dark mode.

screens.name: Patient list
screens.summary: Base list is complete and well aligned; the dark variant is coherent but its active 'All patients' filter chip loses its text label.

issues.observation: The first filter chip in the dark render appears as an icon-only stub; unlike the base render, the 'All patients' label is not visible. Restore the label's visibility and contrast.

screens.name: Register patient
screens.summary: Register form is complete: header actions, required fields, guidance rail and duplicate-check status all fit without clipping.

screens.name: Patient profile
screens.summary: Profile overview is complete; summary card, tabs and chronological timeline remain legible with aligned timestamps and status chips.

screens.name: Edit patient
screens.summary: Edit drawer overlays the profile cleanly; fields, record metadata and footer actions are fully visible and aligned.

screens.name: Duplicate warning
screens.summary: Duplicate warning modal is complete and centred; candidate cards, override reason field and actions fit without clipping.

screens.name: Merge patients
screens.summary: Merge dialog fits the viewport; primary and secondary summary cards and the resolve table align with no clipped columns.

screens.name: Archive patient
screens.summary: Archive confirmation is complete; patient context, linked-record warning, reason field and destructive action are clearly presented.

screens.name: Vaccination visits
screens.summary: Vaccination visit list is complete; KPI cards, filters and the seven-column table fit with consistent chips and totals.

screens.name: Record vaccination
screens.summary: Record vaccination is complete; patient banner, two-row vaccine table, totals and reminder form are legible and aligned.

screens.name: Batch selection
screens.summary: Batch selection modal is clear and complete, with workable row states; only a product-name typo and an awkward subtitle wrap detract.

issues.observation: Modal subtitle reads 'Pentalvent' instead of 'Pentavalent' and wraps the year '2026' onto its own line.

screens.name: Vaccination visit detail
screens.summary: Vaccination visit detail is legible with consistent totals, but the body uses only the left two-thirds, leaving a large empty right column.

issues.observation: Main detail content stops around two-thirds width, leaving a conspicuous blank area on the right below the page actions.

screens.name: Correct or delete vaccination
screens.summary: Correction and deletion dialog is well structured, fully visible and consistent with the package; no blocking issues.

screens.name: Consultations
screens.summary: Consultation list is clean, legible and well spaced; the pagination count does not match the number of visible rows.

issues.observation: Footer reports '1-7 of 428 consultations' although only five table rows are rendered before the pagination bar.

screens.name: New consultation
screens.summary: New consultation form layout is collapsed: fields are squeezed into narrow columns, text wraps word by word, and clinical notes overlap helper text.

issues.observation: Form grid collapses into narrow middle columns; doctor, problem and notes values wrap one word per line, clinical notes overlap the follow-up helper text, and most of the card is blank.

screens.name: Consultation detail
screens.summary: Consultation detail is complete, well balanced and legible, with consistent audit, payment and follow-up information.

screens.name: Delete consultation
screens.summary: Delete consultation dialog is complete and readable, showing audit and payment context before the destructive action.

screens.name: Inventory overview
screens.summary: Inventory overview is clear and well organised; the footer expiry note does not agree with the table's nearest PCV expiry.

issues.observation: Footer says PCV-2411 expires in 12 days, while the PCV row lists a nearest expiry of 12 Nov 2026, about 22 days from 21 Oct.

screens.name: Vaccine catalogue
screens.summary: Vaccine catalogue table is complete and legible, with consistent pricing, statuses and pagination.

screens.name: Edit vaccine catalogue
screens.summary: Edit vaccine drawer is legible but taller than the 768px viewport; save and cancel controls are off-screen and metadata is clipped.

issues.observation: No primary save or cancel action is visible; drawer content runs past the viewport bottom at 'Catalogue metadata', clipping the form and hiding its commit controls.

screens.name: Batch detail
screens.summary: Batch detail is complete and legible, with KPIs, ledger and batch facts aligned. Ledger dates and one reference truncate, and the Batch controls panel appears empty.

issues.observation: Ledger date cells truncate to '20 Oct 2026 ...' and the supplier reference to 'Supplier: Bharat Biote...', slightly reducing scanability.
The 'Batch controls' card shows a heading but no controls or empty-state copy in the viewport.

screens.name: Receive stock
screens.summary: Receive-stock form is clean and complete, with legible fields, helper text and clear primary and cancel actions consistent with the shell.

screens.name: Adjust stock
screens.summary: Adjust-stock data reconciles (28 - 2 = 26), but a detached select chevron renders outside the dialog edge and the action footer sits below the viewport.

issues.observation: A detached white select/chevron fragment renders outside the dialog's right edge over the dimmed backdrop near the Reason field.
The dialog extends past the bottom of the 768px viewport, so no Cancel or Apply action is visible.

screens.name: Wastage overview
screens.summary: Wastage overview is well structured, with consistent KPIs, filters and chart. One reason cell clips 'Cold-chain breakage' mid-word.

issues.observation: The 15 Oct reason cell clips 'Cold-chain breakage' to 'Cold-chain breakd' without an ellipsis.

screens.name: Record wastage
screens.summary: Record-wastage form is coherent and legible; batch context, quantity math (28 - 2 = 26) and audit copy all read correctly.

screens.name: Borrow & return
screens.summary: Borrow/return overview is legible, but status chips clip at the table edge, the active Open tab shows closed records, and BR-1042's due date conflicts with its overdue flag.

issues.observation: The STATUS column clips 'Partially returned' chips at the card's right edge on multiple rows.
The active 'Open 4' tab lists Closed records and the footer says '1-6 of 25 records', contradicting the selected filter.
BR-1042 is due 24 Oct 2026 yet is flagged as overdue by 4 days while the screens are dated 20 Oct 2026.

screens.name: Record borrow / lend
screens.summary: Record borrow/lend layout is broken: the direction and counterparty grid collapses, squeezing inputs to a few characters wide and wrapping helper text one word per line.

issues.observation: Counterparty, contact and reference fields collapse to roughly 40-60px, so entered values wrap one word per line and the direction toggle stacks vertically; the form is not usable.
The first card leaves a large empty area while the 'Vaccine & quantity' card is cut off at the viewport, compounding the broken grid.

screens.name: Record return
screens.summary: Return dialog content and stock math are clear, but its confirm action is below the 768px fold, background status chips clip, and the due date is labelled overdue despite being in the future.

issues.observation: The dialog extends below the viewport; no primary 'Record return' action is visible at 1366x768.
The dialog states 'Due 24 Oct 2026 - overdue' on 20 Oct 2026, which contradicts the date.
Partially returned status chips in the underlying table are clipped at the right edge.

screens.name: Due vaccinations
screens.summary: Due-vaccinations list is complete and well structured; counts, statuses, patient rows and pagination are legible with no visible defects.

screens.name: Vaccination reminder detail
screens.summary: Reminder side panel is readable and matches Aarav Sharma's row, but no completion action is visible within the 768px viewport.

issues.observation: The 'Complete this reminder' section ends with the note field and no visible submit or complete action at 1366x768.

screens.name: Personal reminders
screens.summary: Personal reminders list is complete and legible, with clear tabs, table, pagination and advisory notices. Only small cosmetic text-fitting issues in the search field and linked-patient column.

issues.observation: The search placeholder wraps onto two lines inside a single-line-height input, making the field look cramped.
Linked patient IDs are truncated to "NCC-2026-0..." in every row, reducing their identifying value.

screens.name: Create personal reminder
screens.summary: Create-reminder form layout is broken: the follow-up fields collapse into a narrow column, values wrap word-by-word outside their controls, labels collide, and most of the card is empty.

issues.observation: Reminder, Reminder date, Assigned to and Note are squeezed into a ~90-220px column while the right half of the card is blank; the reminder value renders as a vertical word stack and the note control is unusably small.
The labels Vaccine interest, Advance amount, Reminder and Assigned to run together on one line, and the Assigned-to value overflows its select, so the form cannot be read or used.

screens.name: Finance overview
screens.summary: Finance overview is complete and well balanced: KPI cards, collections trend, payment-method mix and recent transactions are legible with consistent styling and fictional data.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.summary: Transactions list is clear and complete, with readable status badges, cash/online split, consistent table rhythm and working pagination. Truncated references are appropriately ellipsized.

screens.name: Payment detail
screens.summary: Payment detail presents amount, split, status, visit metadata and linked service cleanly. Hierarchy and provisional-receipt treatment are clear with no clipping.

screens.name: Record payment
screens.summary: Record-payment form is well structured and legible, with correct cash/online split messaging, patient context and receipt state. No visible layout or data defects.

screens.name: Expenses
screens.summary: Expenses screen is complete and legible, with clear summary cards, filter controls, status badges and a well-aligned table. No blocking or cosmetic defects noted.

screens.name: Record expense
screens.summary: Record-expense form layout is broken: the field grid collapses into slivers, Title and Note values wrap vertically outside their controls, labels overlap, and the card is mostly blank.

issues.observation: Date, Category, Title and Reference are forced into a narrow column; the Title input is only a few characters wide and its value wraps one word per line beyond the field boundary.
Title and Reference labels overlap, the Note textarea is collapsed to a thin strip with vertically stacked text, and the left half of the form card is empty, making the form unusable.

screens.name: Receipt preview
screens.summary: Receipt preview is complete and convincing: receipt document, totals, payment split, print status and print settings all render cleanly with fictional data and no clipping.

screens.name: Print queue error
screens.summary: Print-queue error state is purposeful and legible, with a clear failure banner, job facts, recovery actions, print options and history. No layout or data defects.

screens.name: Reprint receipt
screens.summary: Reprint dialog is fully visible and legible over the receipt preview, with clear reason, duplicate marking and actions.

screens.name: Statistics overview
screens.summary: Statistics overview is complete with legible KPI cards and chart; the Report views section continues below the fold normally.

screens.name: Vaccination report
screens.summary: Vaccination report renders cleanly with KPI cards, charts, brand mix and a complete table; no clipping or broken data.

screens.name: Finance report
screens.summary: The finance chart is clipped by the daily rows table, hiding the plot's lower area and x-axis labels; this layout overlap needs fixing.

issues.observation: The Income vs expenses chart card is overlapped by the daily rows table at its base, cutting off the plot bottom and x-axis labels.

screens.name: Patient milestone report
screens.summary: The results table overlaps the milestone chart and the By vaccine panel, slicing the vaccine list mid-row; this is a blocking layout defect.

issues.observation: The milestone table begins over the report cards above it, cutting off the By vaccine list mid-row and hiding the chart card's bottom edge.

screens.name: Staff list
screens.summary: Staff list is complete and legible, with a consistent shell, role chips, search, pagination and admin notes.

screens.name: Add staff member
screens.summary: Add staff drawer is clear, but its primary action and role summary sit below the 768px viewport, requiring scroll without a visible footer.

issues.observation: Drawer content extends past the viewport bottom, so the role capability summary and submit action are not visible without scrolling.

screens.name: Deactivate staff
screens.summary: Deactivation dialog is fully visible with legible warnings, reason, note and confirmation controls; the background is appropriately dimmed.

screens.name: Reset staff password
screens.summary: Password reset dialog is complete and legible with account details, delivery note, verification and clear actions.

screens.name: Audit log
screens.summary: Audit log is legible and well structured; source and one action label are ellipsized, and later rows continue below the fold.

issues.observation: Source values such as 'Local → que...' and one action label are truncated; confirm tooltips or slightly wider columns.

screens.name: Audit event detail
screens.summary: Audit event drawer is complete and legible, with clear actor, event, integrity and redacted payload sections; the sidebar shows two emphasized destinations at once.

issues.observation: The sidebar emphasizes both Audit log (tinted row) and Sync center (raised white row), making the current navigation destination ambiguous.

screens.name: Sync center
screens.summary: Sync center is clear and consistent, with a complete outbox table and connection details, but the Sync actions panel is empty.

issues.observation: The Sync actions card renders only its header over a large blank body, with no controls or explanatory content, leaving the right column unfinished.

screens.name: Resolve sync conflict
screens.summary: Conflict comparison, resolution choices and required note are fully visible and legible, with plausible fictional stock data and no clipping.

screens.name: Local data & recovery
screens.summary: Local data and integrity cards are complete and legible, with clear encryption, schema, size and health details; no visual defects observed.

screens.name: Application update
screens.summary: Update and readiness cards are legible, but the Blocked state does not name a blocker and the Install update button still looks available.

issues.observation: Install readiness is marked Blocked while every checklist row shows a check and the primary Install update action remains enabled-looking, with no explicit blocker stated.

screens.name: Backups
screens.summary: Backup stats, history and settings are complete and legible; the Retention helper reads like an implementation note rather than user guidance.

issues.observation: Under Retention, the helper text 'Range validation required.' reads as a developer or specification note instead of clear user-facing range guidance.

screens.name: Create encrypted backup
screens.summary: Create encrypted backup form is complete, with passphrase, destination, confirmation and preview all legible and aligned; no broken data.

screens.name: Restore backup preview
screens.summary: Restore preview clearly presents manifest, compatibility and confirmation, but the primary restore action looks available before the safety snapshot and confirmation are complete.

issues.observation: Restore local data is styled as an available primary action even though the screen reports 5 of 6 checks, Safety snapshot 'Not yet created', and the confirmation form is incomplete.

screens.name: Appearance settings
screens.summary: Appearance settings are clean and consistent in both themes, but the dark variant still displays Light as the selected theme.

issues.observation: The interface renders in dark mode while the Theme control still shows Light selected and Dark unselected, contradicting the applied appearance.

screens.name: Notification settings
screens.summary: Complete, legible notification settings screen with consistent shell, cards and controls; no patient data is exposed.

screens.name: Security & sessions
screens.summary: Complete security settings screen with clear hierarchy and consistent styling. Minor note: its save action sits below the card instead of in the top-right header used by sibling screens.

issues.observation: The primary save button is centered below the card, while sibling settings screens place save actions in the top-right page header.

screens.name: Clinic & safety settings
screens.summary: Complete clinic and safety form with consistent layout and controls. Two numeric fields duplicate their unit suffixes, showing '10 doses doses' and '30 days days'.

issues.observation: Low-stock threshold shows '10 doses' plus a second 'doses' suffix, and expiry warning shows '30 days' plus a second 'days' suffix.
